title: Learning Note 1: Tips for Students
author: Alex Student
excerpt: Quick ideas to improve your workflow and showcase your work.
content: Start with a clear goal for each project: what skill are you demonstrating?
Document your process with screenshots and notes as you go.
Reflect on outcomes: what did you learn and what would you improve?
